name: Student Residence Permit (Type D.1)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a certificate of enrollment and fee payment, or a letter of approval, from a Greek university, plus certification of the total study duration.

Requires proof of sufficient resources of at least EUR 400 per month (including any scholarship), renewable for the duration of study, via deposit account, bank transfer, scholarship certificate, or part-time employment proof.

Requires a health insurance policy covering at least EUR 10,000/year hospital care, EUR 15,000/year permanent disability, and EUR 1,500/year illness/accident medical expenses (each with up to 20% copay), valid in Greece/EU.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initially (or matching a shorter program), renewable up to the standard study period plus 4 semesters (undergraduate) or half the program duration (postgraduate)

sources.title: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens student union -- International students' rights guide (Type D.1 residence permit requirements)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build.
